run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-17T00:54:13Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert rule that is firing is loaded in this Prometheus and tests max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 for 10m. The full cluster inventories (66 pods, 52 services, 36 deployments, 6 StatefulSets, 56 ConfigMaps) contain no Alertmanager workload, Service, Endpoints or ConfigMap anywhere, while the Alertmanager CRD alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com is installed; in namespace prometheus only the operator, kube-state-metrics, the Prometheus pod and five node-exporter pods exist. The most likely explanation is therefore that the Alertmanager component this Prometheus is supposed to notify does not exist in the cluster, so there is no Alertmanager endpoint for Prometheus to discover; an alternative, indistinguishable hypothesis is that the Prometheus resource no longer carries a usable alerting.alertmanagers entry. The Prometheus pod was recreated at 00:53:41Z with an unchanged StatefulSet revision and 0 restarts, which cannot by itself explain a 10-minute-sustained rule firing; all five nodes are Ready. The actual gauge value, the Alertmanager/Prometheus custom resources, the generated config Secret, the pod logs and the change history are not retrievable with the available sources, so the conclusion is partial and no observed object can be named as the root cause.

claims.text: The rule file prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-ac4fa589-688e-4d06-9c48-89982b78688c.yaml inside ConfigMap prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0 (namespace prometheus) defines alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, for: 10m, severity warning, and the description/summary/runbook text matching the alert that opened this investigation.

The complete cluster pod inventory (66 pods) contains no pod whose name identifies an Alertmanager; in namespace prometheus the pods are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh, prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and five prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter pods.

The complete cluster Service inventory (52 services) and the complete Endpoints list of namespace prometheus (5 endpoints) contain no Alertmanager service or endpoints; namespace prometheus exposes prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator (443), prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (9090,8080), prometheus-kube-state-metrics (8080), prometheus-operated (9090) and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter (9100).

The complete cluster StatefulSet inventory (6 StatefulSets) contains no Alertmanager StatefulSet; the entries are chi-clickhouse-main-0-0, jaeger-traces-recorder, prometheus-alert-recorder (an alert-recording component in namespace data-recorders, not Alertmanager), topology-monitor, opensearch-cluster-master and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.

The complete cluster Deployment inventory (36) and ConfigMap inventory (56) contain no Alertmanager-named object; the kube-prometheus-stack components present are Deployment prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator and Deployment prometheus-kube-state-metrics.

The custom resource definition alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com (group monitoring.coreos.com, kind Alertmanager) is installed in the cluster, so an operator-managed Alertmanager resource is supported by the API surface even though no Alertmanager workload is present.

Prometheus pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 started at 2026-11-17T00:53:41Z, its prometheus container started 00:53:42Z, is Ready with restartCount 0, its controller-revision-hash is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59 which equals the StatefulSet's currentRevision and updateRevision, and the StatefulSet shows metadata.generation 1 with observedGeneration 1 - the pod was recreated without a template change.
All five nodes report Ready=True with NetworkUnavailable, MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure all False.
The registered metrics backend scrapes only the jobs kube-state-metrics, kubelet and otel-collector; no Prometheus self-scrape job appears among the job label values in the window.

The surrounding monitoring stack is otherwise present and running: the operator pod, kube-state-metrics pod, node-exporter pods and the Prometheus pod itself are Running and Ready, so this alert is not a symptom of a cluster-wide monitoring outage or of a broken Prometheus pod.

Rejected as the trigger: the Prometheus pod recreation at 2026-11-17T00:53:41Z. The loaded rule requires max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered[5m]) < 1 sustained for 10m, so an alert start of 2026-11-17T00:54:13Z (the investigation anchor) reflects a condition that predates the new pod's start by roughly the whole pending period, and the new pod is Ready with 0 restarts from an unchanged StatefulSet revision.

Rejected: node failure or node pressure as the reason Alertmanager endpoints are missing. All five nodes report Ready with no pressure conditions, and the 26 event groups returned for the window contain no Node involvement.

Primary hypothesis: there is no Alertmanager workload in the cluster for Prometheus to connect to. With no Alertmanager pod, Service, Endpoints, StatefulSet or ConfigMap anywhere in the full cluster inventories, the alerting configuration's Alertmanager target can resolve to zero endpoints, which is exactly the condition the loaded rule tests (max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1). Why the component is absent (deleted, or the release installed with the Alertmanager disabled) is not observable here.

Alternative hypothesis: the Prometheus resource prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus in namespace prometheus no longer carries a usable alerting.alertmanagers entry (cleared or pointing at an object that is gone), which would also keep Alertmanager discovery at zero while the Alertmanager CRD is still installed. This cannot be separated from the missing-workload hypothesis because the Prometheus custom resource and the generated config Secret cannot be read with the available tools.

Advisory: check whether an Alertmanager resource still exists and whether operator-owned Alertmanager objects remain, e.g. kubectl -n prometheus get alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com and kubectl -n prometheus get statefulset,service,endpoints | grep -i alertmanager; if the Alertmanager CR is gone, restoring it (kube-prometheus-stack alertmanager.enabled / re-applying the Alertmanager manifest) is what makes the operator recreate its StatefulSet, headless alertmanager-operated service and generated config secret.

Advisory: read the alerting section actually used by this Prometheus - .spec.alerting.alertmanagers on Prometheus prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus and the operator-generated config it loads (the Secret mounted through the config-reloader, --config-file=/etc/prometheus/config/prometheus.yaml.gz) - to decide between the absent-Alertmanager and cleared-alerting-config hypotheses.

Advisory: query the alerting Prometheus instance itself (service prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus / instance 100.96.5.74:9090, job prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus) for prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered and alertmanager-related series, because those self-metrics are absent from the registered metrics backend used here.

gaps: prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered and every prometheus_* self-metric are unavailable in the registered metrics backend (query {__name__=~"prometheus_.*"} returned no metric names; job values are only kube-state-metrics, kubelet, otel-collector), so the gauge value and its timeline during the incident window are unknown.

No kube_* series are queryable in this backend (kube_pod_owner, kube_pod_container_info and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available returned nothing), so whether an Alertmanager pod existed earlier in the window and when it disappeared cannot be established from metrics.

Logs for prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh returned 0 lines and 0 bytes for the window (filtered and unfiltered), so there is no application-log evidence about config loading, alertmanager configuration errors or the pod recreation at 00:53:41Z.

monitoring.coreos.com custom resources (Alertmanager, Prometheus) cannot be read with the available tools, and Secrets are not readable, so the existence/name of an Alertmanager resource and the generated alerting.alertmanagers configuration are unverified.

Kubernetes events for namespace prometheus are empty for the window and the returned event set only starts at 2026-11-17T01:01:33Z, so a deletion of Alertmanager objects (if any) is not observable; the change_history integration is not integrated, so when and how the components disappeared is unknown.

Queries for NetworkPolicy and ResourceQuota returned no objects, but those views are empty (no_data) and cannot be cited as proof of absence, so network or quota blocking as a contributing factor is unverified in either direction.

The Alertmanager alert payload itself is the only direct statement that Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers; the underlying Prometheus scrape and Alertmanager configuration were not directly observable, and the alert payload is untrusted input.
next_steps: Compare the Alertmanager expectation in the kube-prometheus-stack release values (alertmanager.enabled, alertmanagerSpec.replicas) with the actual cluster state to confirm whether the component was disabled or deleted.

Check cluster audit logs or GitOps history for deletion of Alertmanager resources or edits to the Prometheus resource between 2026-11-17T00:44:00Z and 2026-11-17T00:54:13Z, since change history is not integrated in this Run.

After restoring an Alertmanager, confirm recovery by observing prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered >= 1 on the Prometheus instance and the resolution of PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers, and verify that other alerts on this Prometheus resume delivery.
